summary: Close-up of the guest taking in the host's answer: a flat stare that hardens into a scowl as he repeats it back as a question.
framing: Close-up, head and collar, eye level, static. Guest left of centre, a window frame at right, a green-framed oval mirror with flowers at bottom left.

cast.costume: navy suit, white shirt, red tie

props: window with pale frame and purple pane, right edge
green-framed oval mirror showing pink flowers, bottom left

beats.action: stares to screen right, head still; brows level and slightly raised, upper lids low over the eyes, mouth closed in a downturned line
brows drop a little and slant inward; mouth opens for a short grunt
holds the stare, mouth barely parted, no blink
brows slant down further toward the nose
head tips back and turns slightly more to the right as he starts to speak, lips pursed forward
brows lift at the outer ends, inner ends still down (sceptical), lids low
head comes back down, jaw drops wide
mouth shuts into a long downturned line for two frames
head tips back again, lips pursed
brows clamp down into a hard V, jaw drops wide, head pushes forward
teeth clenched and bared, full scowl
head dips and turns a little further right, teeth still bared, glaring; held to the cut

notes: Camera static, as measured. He does not blink in this shot. The head moves are small (a few percent of head height) and follow the mouth shapes; the main animated change is the brows: level at 3272, slightly lowered at 3276, sceptical at 3304, hard V from 3320. S42-S44 continue this setup with punch-ins.
